# nix-config Documentation

SME: NIXEY (Infrastructure)
Curator: LIBBY (Documentation Voice)

## Host Categories

Container Hosts (4): monolith, pilaster, zenith, obelisk
Workstations (5): chassis, framework, jbookpro, jmacmini, studio
Raspberry Pi (8): rpc-5-{alpha,bravo,charlie,delta}, rpc-4-{echo,foxtrot,golf,hotel}
Other (7): armistice, void, gap, tty-ruinous-social, ruinous-tty, messy-tty

## Networks

| Network | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| servicenet | Inter-container + Caddy |
| datanet | Internal databases (--internal) |
| proxynet | Host port binding |

## DNS Domains

- meskill.farm: Internal production
- ruinous.ai: Agent ecosystem
- ruinous.social: Public-facing

Secrets: /encrypt-secret, /view-secret, /rekey-secrets

Containers: /deploy-container, /create-db-*
Packaging: /create-nix-package, /update-package

## Commands

```bash
just check [host]              # Verify build (dry-build)
just deploy [host]             # Deploy configuration
just unlock                    # Before secrets
just rekey                     # After changes
```
